name: grammar-profiler
description: Profile the grammar of English text by CEFR level — which constructions it uses (tenses, aspect, passive, modals, relative clauses, conditionals, non-finite forms) and what CEFR level each maps to. Rule-based over a spaCy parse; uses the CEFR-J Grammar Profile. Requires Python 3, spaCy, and the en_core_web_sm model.
